## Checklist

- [ ] `bun test packages` and `bun run typecheck` pass
- [ ] User-visible change → the matching page in `docs/guide/` **and** its `.zh.md` twin are updated (or: no user-visible change)
- [ ] Setting / env var / CLI change → `settings-reference.ts` or `help.ts` updated and `bun scripts/gen-docs.ts` run
- [ ] New or changed domain term → `CONTEXT.md`
- [ ] Hard-to-reverse decision → new ADR in `docs/develop/adr/`
- [ ] No attribution lines in commits or this description
